seo.description_so: La shaqee BajGo. Safarro badan, dakhli caddaalad ah, Bajaajkaaga. Baro faa'iidooyinka, shuruudaha iyo tallaabooyinka isdiiwaangelinta.
seo.description_en: Drive with BajGo. More trips. Fair pay. Your Bajaaj. Learn the benefits, requirements and registration steps.

so.headline: La shaqee BajGo. Safarro badan, dakhli caddaalad ah, Bajaajkaaga.
so.sub: Darawallada BajGo waa shuraako. Waxaad aragtaa dakhliga safar kasta ka hor intaadan aqbalin, oo waxaad shaqaysaa waqtiga kugu habboon.

en.headline: Drive with BajGo. More trips. Fair pay. Your Bajaaj.
en.sub: BajGo drivers are partners. You see the earnings for every trip before you accept, and you work the hours that suit you.

steps.title: Dakhli cad
steps.body: Safar kasta waxaad aragtaa qiimaha iyo dakhligaaga ka hor intaadan aqbalin. Komishanka BajGo wuu muuqdaa.

steps.title: Safarro iyo dirid
steps.body: Isla app-ka ayaad ka helaysaa safarro rakaab ah iyo dirid xirmooyin, waqti kasta oo aad online tahay.

steps.title: Waqtigaaga
steps.body: Online noqo markaad rabto, offline noqo markaad rabto. Ma jiraan saacado qasab ah.

steps.title: Taageero
steps.body: Koox Garoowe jooga ayaa ku taageeraysa. Waxaad helaysaa badhanka gurmadka iyo taageero app-ka dhexdiisa.

steps.title: Clear earnings
steps.body: For every trip you see the fare and your earnings before you accept. BajGo's commission is visible.

steps.title: Rides and deliveries
steps.body: The same app brings you passenger rides and parcel deliveries whenever you are online.

steps.title: Your hours
steps.body: Go online when you want, go offline when you want. There are no required hours.

steps.title: Support
steps.body: A team based in Garowe supports you. You get an emergency button and in-app support.

so.title: Shuruudaha
so.body:
Si aad darawal BajGo u noqoto waxaad u baahan tahay:

- Aqoonsi rasmi ah oo shaqeynaya.
- Shati wadis oo shaqeynaya.
- Bajaaj xaalad wanaagsan ku jira, oo leh diiwaangelin iyo caymis haddii ay jiraan.
- Taleefan Android ah oo internet leh.
- Lambar taleefan oo xiriir degdeg ah (qof ehel ah ama saaxiib).
- Dhaqan wanaagsan oo ixtiraam leh rakaabka iyo qaatayaasha.

Darawallada aan Bajaaj lahayn waxay weli codsan karaan; waxaan la xiriiri doonnaa marka fursado jiraan.

en.title: Requirements
en.body:
To become a BajGo driver you need:

- A valid official ID.
- A valid driving licence.
- A Bajaaj in good condition, with registration and insurance where they exist.
- An Android phone with internet.
- An emergency contact number (a family member or friend).
- A respectful attitude towards riders and recipients.

Drivers without a Bajaaj can still apply; we will get in touch when there are opportunities.

steps.title: Buuxi foomka
steps.body: Buuxi foomka isdiiwaangelinta ee boggan. Waxay qaadataa dhowr daqiiqo.

steps.title: Waan ku soo wacaynaa
steps.body: Xubin ka tirsan kooxda BajGo ayaa ku soo wici doonta si ay kuula qabanqaabiso hubinta dukumeentiyada Garoowe.

steps.title: Hubinta
steps.body: Waxaan hubinaa aqoonsigaaga, shatigaaga iyo Bajaajkaaga. Waxaad helaysaa koodh gaari oo BajGo ah.

steps.title: Bilow
steps.body: Soo deji app-ka darawalka, online noqo, oo aqbal safarkaaga ugu horreeya.

steps.title: Fill in the form
steps.body: Complete the registration form on this website. It takes a few minutes.

steps.title: We call you
steps.body: A BajGo team member will call to arrange document checks in Garowe.

steps.title: Verification
steps.body: We check your ID, licence and Bajaaj. You receive a BajGo fleet code.

steps.title: Start
steps.body: Download the driver app, go online, and accept your first trip.

so.title: Diyaar ma u tahay inaad la shaqayso BajGo?
so.body: Buuxi foomka, waana ku soo wici doonnaa.
so.label: Hadda codso

en.title: Ready to drive with BajGo?
en.body: Fill in the form and we will call you.
en.label: Apply now
